summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and voluntary HKEX announcement updating its two-year $300 million share repurchase program adopted in June 2026. As of June 30, 2026, the company had repurchased 1.9 million listed securities at a total cost of ~$31.3 million under the program, and 4.8 million securities for ~$100.1 million in the six months ended June 30, 2026. No specific price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. This is an ordinary capital return update with no special situation mechanics, overhang, or regulatory clock. Watch for future repurchase pace as an indicator of management's capital allocation confidence.
